description:
The One Time Settlement Scheme (OTSS) is a government initiative aimed at providing relief to borrowers who are unable to repay their loans. 

The scheme is designed to facilitate a one-time settlement of outstanding loans for individuals and businesses. 

Its primary objective is to reduce the burden of debt on borrowers and help them regain financial stability. 

The benefits of the OTSS include the waiver of penalties and interest on outstanding loans. 

Eligible beneficiaries typically include individuals and businesses with non-performing assets or loans that are in default. 

The application process usually involves submitting a request to the concerned financial institution or bank. 

The timeline for the settlement process may vary depending on the institution's policies. 

The scheme is implemented by various financial institutions and banks under the guidelines set by the Reserve Bank of India. 

Additional details regarding specific eligibility criteria and application procedures may vary by institution.
